with d as (select article_id, ' '||regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(title,'')||' '||coalesce(description,'')),'[^a-z0-9.\-]+',' ','g')||' ' as txt from arts),
lx as (select distinct cat, kw from lex),
s as (select d.article_id, lx.cat, sum((len(d.txt)-len(replace(d.txt,' '||kw||' ','')))//(len(kw)+2)) as sc
 from d cross join lx group by all),
r as (select article_id, cat, sc, row_number() over (partition by article_id order by sc desc, cat) rn, lead(sc) over (partition by article_id order by sc desc, cat) sc2 from s)
select article_id, cat, sc, sc2 from r where rn=1 and sc>=2 and sc>=sc2+2

name: materialized joins with prior aliases

input.sql:
with wc as (select l.c, t.w, count(*) n from toks t join lab0 l using(article_id) group by 1,2),
vocab as (select w from wc group by w having sum(n)>=3),
V as (select count(*) v from vocab),
tot as (select c, sum(n) tn from wc where w in (select w from vocab) group by c),
cls as (select distinct c from lab0),
prior as (select c, ln(count(*)*1.0/(select count(*) from lab0)) lp from lab0 group by c),
lp as (select cls.c, vocab.w, ln((coalesce(wc.n,0)+1.0)/(tot.tn+(select v from V))) l
 from cls cross join vocab join tot on tot.c=cls.c left join wc on wc.c=cls.c and wc.w=vocab.w),
sc as (select t.article_id, lp.c, sum(lp.l) s from toks t join lp using(w) group by 1,2),
sc2 as (select sc.article_id, sc.c, sc.s+prior.lp s from sc join prior using(c))
select article_id, arg_max(c, s) c from sc2 group by 1
